changelog: **COMPANY calendar (#2005, 1/3):** `/company/calendar` mounts the shared `CalendarView` on the company shell. `GET /api/calendar-events` now gives a COMPANY session the meetings scheduled from its own interview requests (filter = the COMPANY branch of `interviewRequestActorWhere()`, inside the caller's tenant) and nothing else — no mentor↔mentee meeting, deadline, logged interaction or project call; a company login without a company assignment gets an empty list. Every role outside ADMIN/MENTOR/MENTEE/COMPANY (SOURCE, AFFILIATE, …) is now refused with 401 instead of falling into the mentee branch. Pinned by `e2e/company-calendar.spec.ts` (@smoke).

en: Companies get a calendar: a company login now sees its own scheduled interviews, and nothing else, under Calendar.
tr: Şirketlere takvim: şirket hesabı artık Takvim altında kendi planlanmış mülakatlarını — yalnızca onları — görüyor.
de: Kalender für Firmen: Ein Firmenkonto sieht unter „Kalender“ jetzt seine eigenen geplanten Vorstellungsgespräche – und nur diese.
